title: Electing Members to certain standing committees of the House of Representatives.
latestAction: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
summary:
This resolution elects designated Members of the House of Representatives to

  • the Committee on the Budget,
  • the Committee on House Administration,
  • the Committee on Natural Resources, and
  • the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform.
